items.note: This app cannot hear you. A teacher with a sanad can, and only a teacher can grant an ijazah. These connect you with one online.

items.name: مقرأة الحرمين
items.body: The online maqraʾa of the Two Holy Mosques: live recitation sessions with qualified teachers, with a section for women.

items.name: المقرأة الإلكترونية العالمية، الجامعة الإسلامية
items.body: Run under the Quran College of the Islamic University of Madinah. Teachers with a sanad, in all ten readings.

items.name: Maqraatec
items.body: A free app with certified teachers for correcting recitation and memorisation, at any hour.

items.name: Qutor
items.body: Paid one-to-one tutors who set their own rates, with a free 30-minute trial.

items.note: Bring your teacher log: Teacher keeps their corrections, and a share link shows them your progress.

items.name: المصحف المعلم، الحصري
items.body: He reads, pauses, and you repeat. The best daily model.

items.name: المصحف المعلم، المنشاوي مع الأطفال
items.body: Children repeat after him, so you hear common mistakes being corrected.

items.name: Quran.com
items.body: Ayah audio and word-by-word playback. The player links there for every passage.

items.name: تعلم التجويد بطريقة عملية مبسطة، م. علاء حامد
items.body: Your intro course: 6 practical episodes. The course units follow its surahs, and each lesson links to the moment its rule is explained.

items.name: التجويد المصور، د. أيمن سويد
items.body: The most detailed visual explanation of المخارج والصفات. Use it with unit 9.

items.name: تحفة الأطفال، الجمزوري
items.body: 61 lines on النون والميم واللام والمد. The unit pages show the lines that match each unit.

items.name: المقدمة الجزرية، ابن الجزري
items.body: 107 lines on المخارج, الصفات and all the rules. The standard text for mastery.

items.name: مصحف التجويد الملوّن، دار المعرفة
items.body: The colours in this app follow its scheme, so your eye learns both at once.

items.name: القاعدة النورانية
items.body: Only if reading letters and vowels is still slow. Use it alongside the first units.

items.name: Tajweed Rules of the Qur'an
items.body: Kareema Carol Czerepinski, 3 parts. A clear English textbook with exercises.

items.name: Tarteel
items.body: Listens while you recite and flags missed or wrong words. It cannot judge fine tajweed; a teacher still can.

en.text: . Converted to per-ayah spans; colours mapped to the muṣḥaf palette.
